facts.value: These courses aim to impart communicative and intercultural foreign language skills, refresh and complete existing basic knowledge in the Spanish language, and provide specialized vocabulary as well as an initial insight into general aspects of the economy of Spain and Latin America.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Two levels are offered: Economic Spanish 1 - Base and Economic Spanish 2 - Consolidation.
